name: NIFTY 50
about: India's benchmark stock index: the 50 largest companies on the National Stock Exchange (NSE). Prices are in index points, not rupees. The market is open 9:15 to 15:30 IST on weekdays.

news.query: (nifty OR sensex OR "indian stocks" OR "indian shares" OR "indian equities" OR "reserve bank of india" OR "dalal street") sourcelang:english

name: Gold
about: COMEX gold futures: the international gold price in US dollars per troy ounce (about 31.1 g). Indian MCX gold is quoted in rupees per 10 g and includes import duty, so its numbers look very different.

news.query: ("gold price" OR "gold prices" OR "gold futures" OR "spot gold" OR bullion) sourcelang:english

name: Silver
about: COMEX silver futures, in US dollars per troy ounce. Indian MCX silver is quoted in rupees per kg.

news.query: ("silver price" OR "silver prices" OR "silver futures" OR "spot silver") sourcelang:english

name: Crude Oil
about: WTI crude oil futures (the US benchmark), in US dollars per barrel.
